newsitem.title: USA: U.S. House's Armey sees money bill by end of week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. House's Armey sees money bill by end of week.

text.p: House Majority Leader Dick Armey, R-Texas, said Tuesday he expects Congress will complete work by the end of the week on fiscal 1997 spending bills given that talks with Democrats and the White House on details were going well.
"I think the substantive issues are coming into place," Armey told reporters. "It is my expectation that it will be on the House floor by Thursday or Friday at the latest."
It will include measures to bolster the thrift deposit Insurance fund and ease regulatory burdens on banks, he said.
